_source: Test5 - NZ, samples.id=141 (Soccer, soil) TEMPORARILY mutated in the dev DB on 2026-09-08 via docker exec gilba_mysql: UPDATE samples SET payload = JSON_SET(payload, '$.K', '40', '$.P', '10') WHERE id = 141 (every other field left as stored: Ca 803, Mg 129, S 75, pH 6, CEC 5.9). inputs._bulkDensityDepthNote: Defaults (nutrition-calendar.js CONFIG.defaultBulkDensity/defaultSoilDepth, mirrored by nutrition-requirement-engine.js DEFAULT_BULK_DENSITY_G_CM3/DEFAULT_SOIL_DEPTH_CM). Sample 141 has no bulkDensity/depthCm field, so this is the factor both live surfaces actually used (console: 'bulkDensity: 1.4, soilDepth: 10' on both).

expected._gh381Note: GH-381 fixed the N-basis divergence this fixture originally documented: nutrition-requirement-engine.js's getRemovalRate() scaled removal against the species table's own N (180 for perennial ryegrass) instead of the site's real annualN (250), for BOTH the tissue-informed and generic branches. The combinedExport block below is the RECOMPUTED post-fix figure (direct Engine.compute() call, same inputs, verified against tests/fixtures/test5-soccer-sample141-belowfloor-gh370.json's own inputs) -- not re-captured live in the browser in this pass, unlike the original GH-370 numbers. It now matches sharedCore exactly (both scale from the real annualN) and planPage closely (84.1 vs 84, 40.9 vs 41 -- the small residual is generic-ratio precision, 100/180=0.5556 vs the calendar's 0.55 constant, not a basis mismatch). The ORIGINAL pre-fix live numbers (K req 68.1, P req 31.4, removal 41.4/24.4) are preserved in _preGh381LiveRender for history; do not use them as current expectations.

combinedExport._surface: word-export-combined.js ANR pass -> NutritionRequirementEngine_Pure.compute(); removal is tissue-ratio-governed, scaled against the site's real annualN=250 as of GH-381 (previously the species table N=180 -- GH-376 divergence item 1, now closed), correction is the converted term above

_preGh381LiveRender._note: The actual live-rendered .docx figures from the original GH-370 verification pass, before GH-381's N-basis fix. Kept for history only.

planPage._surface: nutrition-calendar.js computeProgram(); removal is the same tissue ratio scaled against the site's real annualN=250, correction is the converted term above
planPage._gh403Note: GH-403 removed the whole-kilogram rounding nutrition-calendar.js applied to the core's annual requirement before distributing it, and made the Plan panel print that requirement instead of re-deriving it by summing the twelve monthly rows. The Plan's figures below therefore MOVED, to the figures this same fixture already records for the document (combinedExport.annualNutrientRequirementsRow: K_req 84.1, P_req 40.9) -- which is the whole point of the ticket: one quantity, one number, on both surfaces. The pre-GH-403 values are kept in _preGh403PlanRender for history. They were captured live on 2026-09-08 against a temporarily mutated sample 141 that has since been restored, so the post-GH-403 figures here are RECOMPUTED from the same inputs through the same code, not re-captured in the browser; they are corroborated by the live-captured document row, which they now equal exactly.

_preGh403PlanRender._whyThreeDifferentNumbers: 84 was Math.round(84.1) taken BEFORE the annual was distributed; 84.2 was the sum of the twelve monthly rows, each rounded to 1 dp, that the panel re-derived Required from; 84.1 was, and is, the engine's answer. One column name, three numbers.
